W1.scope: authenticated actor, current sync freshness, theme persistence, and isolated auth lifecycle

auth_lifecycle.guard_requirement: stagingSession uses its mode-600 private secret through the supervised API context. A distinct browser context accepts only exact staging auth and static reads plus one CSRF-bound signout for its own cookie; every forwarded request uses the supervised HTTP budget. Never sign out the caller's shared session.
auth_lifecycle.current_source_limit: The pinned CARR signout responds with a redirect to / and /auth/login starts OAuth. The app shell's fetch-based signout needs a real visible signed-out state before W1 can qualify. A redirect attempt alone is not signed-out UI evidence.
